contexts.text: The pleasures of conversation with companions.
Spirits can thus... converse with every Spirit, of whatever language...
From the interior memory in the other life one can speak and converse with all in the universe.
Is there not happiness from other sources, as from conversation, discourse, meditation?
Spirits and Angels have social intercourse with each other like men, and converse together.
They who had preferred the delight of social intercourse to every other delight, and who have loved those with whom they have had social intercourse, caring not whether they were good or evil...
If the end be the pleasure of conversation, etc...
He was one of the subtle evil Spirits, because he had indulged more in thought than in discourse and social intercourse.
Angels could then converse with men.
They who are in Heaven can speak and have intercourse with (Angels, Spirits, and men of other solar systems).
(The inhabitants of the sixth Earth) have social intercourse with those who are within the same family.
He may have social intercourse with others...
Either from report or from conversation.
Flowing in... by conversation...
They leave their work, and love only company, talking, etc.
When remitted into a state like that of the body, Spirits converse in exactly the same way.
Sometimes during conversation (I have been in a state of interior thought).
Simulated friendships, for the sake of sweet conversations.
They excel in cleverness of conversation.
From the internals, thus from the end and love, do Spirits converse and speak together.
Spirits speak together from the interior memory... Hence it is that all Souls, of whatever language, can converse and speak together.
All there know hypocrites from a slight conversation.
There are Spirits who in the world have had social intercourse with others without any end except mere presence...
(Conversation as a recreation.)
